caption: The drawing features a central, stylized bird colored in shades of red and pink with outstretched wings and an upturned tail; it has a yellow beak and stands on green stems with its head facing left. Surrounding the bird are five-petaled blue flowers: two larger ones to the bird’s left and right, and a small cluster of blue flowers at the upper left corner. At the bottom center is a large flower with a circular pink or reddish center, surrounded by green stems and leaves. There are red or pink buds on either side of the large central flower, with curved green stems ending in pointed leaves at the bottom left and right corners. The numbers “17” and “33” appear near the bottom, left and right of the central stem respectively. Green leafy stems and additional curling stems frame the composition against a light brownish background, which is set within a larger off-white or cream-colored page. The drawing mainly utilizes red, green, blue, yellow, and pink colors with black or dark outlines.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
